__comment: From 1.20.5 a map decoration is a MapDecorationType registry entry whose assetId names a sprite on the map_decorations atlas, so the mod's cabin marker is drawn by vanilla instead of by the hand-rolled quad ClientEvents used to emit. Atlas definitions merge across namespaces, so this file only has to contribute alexscaves' own directory. Inert below 1.20.5, where that atlas does not exist.
